approach: Static MIPS-to-C recompilation with a shared native runtime and RT64 Vulkan rendering.
notes: Multi-game N64 recompilation project. This entry describes GoldenEye 007 US: original startup, menus and playable Dam, with a validated live Dam virtual gamepad/rendering check. Linux Debug/Release and Steam Deck builds pass. CPU inventory is partial and remaining unsupported functions fail explicitly; full-game progression remains unverified. Physical Steam Deck controls, broader widescreen transitions, full-range FOV gameplay and the reported Dam performance drop still need validation or investigation. See the repository for other game-specific milestones. Users supply their own game data.
